subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four guard assertions are repaired and exact-head validation is green, do the workflow and security owners approve landing these privileged action upgrades as one grouped rollup?
rationale: The changed revisions execute with credentials or security-sensitive permissions across several owner boundaries, so repository history and automated validation cannot supply the required owner acceptance.

options.title: Approve grouped rollup
options.body: Repair the guard assertions, validate the exact head, and land the verified official revisions together.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Separate token, publishing, scanning, and Codex action updates into smaller owner-reviewed pull requests.

options.title: Pause the rollup
options.body: Close or supersede this PR if repeated Dependabot rebases cannot retain the repository-specific guard repair.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped rollup
recommendation.body: Repair the guard assertions, validate the exact head, and land the verified official revisions together.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history attributes all three currently broken workflow families to this person, making them the strongest available individual routing candidate alongside the CODEOWNERS teams.
